messages:
maria: Quick sync — we're planning a small X + LinkedIn push for the launch next Tue 9am PT. Need to lock final messaging variants, assets (30s clip + 16:9 hero), and inbound lead routing. Who can own the routing to HubSpot? Link to doc: https://docs.google.com/example (please comment A/B copy)
sam: I can own scheduling. Planning two variants: A = product benefits (short bullets), B = benchmark narrative (latency/cost win). Which goes on org X vs. company LinkedIn? Also: can we do a seeded employee post an hour before org post?
kevin: Clip status: edit pass done, color grade in progress. Will export 29-31s MP4 with burned captions and separate SRT by EOD. Will upload to Drive -> filename: launch_clip_v3.mp4 :thumbsup:
tara: For inbound routing I'd prefer direct HubSpot form webhook rather than Zapier (less flakiness). I can set a pipeline and add property: source=launch-social, utm_campaign=launch_apr. Who wants lead notifications in #sales-inbound?
maria: Good call on UTMs. For channels: org LinkedIn = variant B (benchmark narrative), X = variant A (product benefits, punchy). Employee seed = variant A short teaser. Sam, can you schedule employee posts at 8am PT, org/X at 9am PT, LinkedIn at 9:15am PT? 
sam: Yep. I'll also set a follow-up wave at +6 hours if engagement < 300 interactions. If >500 likes, trigger wave 2 with case study CTA. Will add to scheduler.
kevin: Uploaded assets to Drive: /marketing/launch/assets/launch_clip_v3.mp4, hero_16x9_v2.png, hero_thumb.png. Also attached a 1:1 vertical clip for stories. If you need different sizes tell me now.
maria: Can someone add the copy variants into the sheet? I'll do A, Tara please add the HubSpot form action + hidden field mapping. Copy snippets below — pick tone you like.

```text
Variant A (X): "Inference that scales — launch today. Faster, cheaper, predictable. Watch the 30s demo. ▶️"
Variant B (LinkedIn): "How we reduced per-query latency by 40% and costs by 30% for production LLM workloads — a short breakdown and demo."
```

tara: HubSpot workflow plan: form -> list 'launch_leads' -> assign to SDR queue -> tag 'social_launch_apr'. I'll add a notification to #sales-inbound for critical leads (score >50). Need confirm on form fields: name, email, company, use-case, consent checkbox.
sam: Scheduler CSV I'm using (will import into the tool):

```csv
platform,post_time_utc,variant,asset
X,2026-04-05T16:00:00Z,A,launch_clip_v3.mp4
LinkedIn,2026-04-05T16:15:00Z,B,hero_16x9_v2.png
Employee_X,2026-04-05T15:00:00Z,A,hero_thumb.png
```

kevin: Uploaded S3 path for the clip if needed: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/launch_clip_v3.mp4
social-bot: Draft posts created in scheduler (id: sch_89421). Preview links posted in thread.
maria: Perfect. Next steps: sam lock the times, kevin finalize captions, tara create HubSpot form/workflow and post the webhook URL here, I'll finalize copy in the doc. Everyone pls react when done so I can close the task. :rocket:
sam: Locked times and added to calendar event.
kevin: Captions exported and uploaded.
tara: HubSpot form + workflow created, webhook sent to crm@redwood.com. Workflow id: hs_wf_2209. I'll monitor first 50 leads and report.
maria: Awesome — thanks team. Will coordinate engagement follow-ups (short thread replies from ops + 1:1 outreach for demo requests). :party-parrot:"
